sections.content: How many people stayed in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) after gaining qualifications?

Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) is a medium-sized town in the North West. Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) does not have its own university.

Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) has higher levels of deprivation.

Overall, Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) ended up with:

  • fewer graduates than it produced
  • a similar number of non-graduates with advanced qualifications as it produced
Note: all towns and cities in this analysis are defined based on population size only. This means that some cities are classed as towns because of their population.

Let's explore this further

There were 1,775 state-school pupils from Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) who sat their GCSEs between the 2007 to 2008 and the 2010 to 2011 school years.

Of these, 340 (19%) went on to gain degree-level qualifications (level 6+ as defined by The Office of Qualifications and Examinations Regulation, or Ofqual ). We will call these people graduates.

Another 650 (37%) went on to gain other advanced post-16 qualifications, such as A-Levels, a foundation degree or higher apprenticeship (levels 3-5 as defined by Ofqual). In this tool, we will refer to these non-graduates with advanced qualifications as “qualified non-graduates", for brevity.

The charts below compare Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) to other English towns and cities using three measures:

  • what proportion of Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester)'s pupils became graduates or qualified non-graduates by the 2017 to 2018 academic year
  • of those graduates and qualified non-graduates, the percentages that lived in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) in the 2018 to 2019 academic year
  • how many graduates and qualified non-graduates from elsewhere came to live there by 2018 to 2019, relative to the number who sat their GCSEs there

In some towns, some of this information may not be available because of small sample sizes.
The size and deprivation level of a town, as well as the qualification levels of older residents, were all related to students' educational attainment. Read our previous analysis.

Where did those who left Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) move to?

Of Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester)'s graduates, 125 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

Of Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester)'s qualified (level 3+) non-graduates, 140 were living elsewhere in 2018/19.

However, 65 of those qualified non-graduates (46%) were living fairly locally, in the Crewe travel to work area (TTWA).

Of those in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester)'s GCSE cohort:

  • 60 graduates left the North West
  • 35 qualified (level 3+) non-graduates left the North West

In 2018 to 2019, 23% of graduates and 21% of qualified non-graduates living in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) had moved there from elsewhere

In the 2018 to 2019 academic year, there were 280 graduates and 625 qualified (level 3+) non-graduates from our cohort living in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester). This is compared with the 340 graduates and 650 qualified non-graduates who had lived there when they sat their GCSEs.

In 2018 to 2019, 77% of the graduates had also lived in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) as GCSE pupils, while 23% had moved there from elsewhere.

Of the qualified non-graduates who lived in Winsford (Cheshire West and Chester) in 2018 to 2019, 79% had lived there as GCSE pupils, while 21% had moved to the area from elsewhere.
